Each Loan uses exactly one LibraryService, and each LibraryService serves zero or more Loan records. Each LibraryService manages one or more Book records by composition, and each Book belongs to exactly one LibraryService. Each Reader can reference zero or more Book records, and each Book can be referenced by zero or more Reader records.
